heading.editorialNote: [TRANSFER OF CCC FUNDS FOR CLASSING AND GRADING PURPOSES]

section.content: Hereafter there may be transferred to appropriations available for classing or grading any agricultural commodity without charge to the producers thereof such sums from nonadministrative funds of the Commodity Credit Corporation as may be necessary in addition to other funds available for these purposes, such transfers to be reimbursed from subsequent appropriations therefor.
